g.aria-label: X-axis titled 'Year' for a discrete scale with 117 values: 1900, 1901, 1902, 1903, 1905, ending with 2017
Y-axis for a discrete scale with 10 values: Drought, Earthquake, Epidemic, Extreme temperature, Extreme weather, ending with Wildfire
Symbol legend titled 'Annual Global Deaths' for size with values from 0 to 3,700,000
